correction.A_history: CanvasAudit is append-only. Every original audit/receipt/operation row is byte-for-byte immutable. Current writable projections may be rebased. When read_canvas needs a current content-bearing row, restore appends a new restore-owned CanvasAudit event with a new id, exact canvas/tenant scope, original audit id + created_at + original details hash + manifest SHA-256 provenance, and the target binding. It removes old operation_id, evidence_refs, postconditions and review_status; user_id/agent_id stay NULL.
correction.B_binding: The database copy is bound to the exact bytes validated against the manifest. The already-checkpointed backup file is opened through a nofollow directory-descriptor walk, frozen into private staging, re-verified for size/SHA-256/device/inode/stat identity, and only then read by the SQLite backup API. In-place updates, path/inode swaps, symlink swaps, sidecar changes and changes during read are refused. No live DB or unmanifested WAL is read.

hardening.row_counts: keys must be simple SQL identifiers; values are non-negative int or None; missing tables are never silently zero; 0 is exact; None requires absence
hardening.target: target must not exist; target/ancestor symlinks refused; claim token+inode ownership checked before cleanup; renamex_np/RENAME_EXCL or renameat2/RENAME_NOREPLACE prevents peer target overwrite
hardening.producer: backup leaves a self-contained checkpointed sidecar-free DB and rejects symlinks/hardlinks in managed stores
